tools.name: list_public_projects
tools.description: List publicly shared electronics projects from the ElectroGen community gallery. Returns card-shaped summaries (title, description, platform, difficulty, estimated time/cost, tags, links). Use get_capabilities or the apiUrl field for full blueprints.

tools.name: get_component_products
tools.description: Query the ElectroGen component marketplace: validated modules, sensors, boards, and kits with brand, category, tags, price range, availability, rating, and vendor links.

tools.name: list_news_posts
tools.description: List published ElectroGen AI news articles — DIY electronics guides, product updates, and release notes. Returns slug, title, excerpt, topic, publish date, reading time, and links; fetch the apiUrl for the full article body.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return ElectroGen runtime capabilities and catalog metadata: which backend features are enabled (db, auth, AI providers), the plan tier catalog, the feature list, and the public API endpoints.

tools.name: describe_platform
tools.description: Return a marketing-accurate description of ElectroGen AI: what it does, who it is for, the prompt-to-blueprint pipeline, supported platforms, plan tiers, and links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_news_posts · Private data: get_capabilities · Public sink: list_news_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_news_posts · Private data: get_capabilities · Public sink: list_news_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
